analyst.summary: Force Motors combines its own commercial-vehicle and tractor business with a long-standing engine-supply partnership for Mercedes-Benz and BMW in India, on a debt-free balance sheet. Revenue is still growing, but quarterly profit fell sharply in the most recent quarter, and the company's own April sales update pointed to supply-chain and labour-related softness carrying into the new year. We rate this a Hold: a resilient, conservatively financed franchise, but recent trends argue for caution rather than conviction.
